standards.mitre_attack: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise, including T1071.001 Web Protocols
standards.wstg: OWASP Web Security Testing Guide v4.2

tests.test_name: ATT&CK T1071.001 Web Protocols - HTTPS edge and method boundary
tests.expected_result: HTTPS responds for OSMAP while unsafe or tunnel-style HTTP methods are rejected.
evidence_produced: method boundary response headers and bodies

tests.test_name: ATT&CK T1071.001 Web Protocols - suspicious endpoint exposure
tests.expected_result: Common webshell, beacon, framework, and diagnostics paths do not expose live handlers or secrets.

tests.test_name: ATT&CK T1190 Public-Facing Application - control-plane route exposure
tests.expected_result: Adjacent admin and operator paths are not publicly reachable from the internet edge.

tests.test_name: ATT&CK T1190 Public-Facing Application - spoofed proxy header trust boundary
tests.expected_result: Client-supplied forwarding headers do not unlock private control-plane paths.

tests.test_name: OWASP A05 Host Header Boundary - virtual host confusion
tests.expected_result: Unexpected Host headers do not serve the OSMAP authenticated interface.

tests.test_name: OWASP A03 Injection - diagnostic disclosure probes
owasp_top_10: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
tests.expected_result: Benign injection-shaped requests do not expose SQL, stack, Rust panic, or backend diagnostics.

tests.test_name: OWASP A10 SSRF - internal URL parameter probes
tests.expected_result: URL-like parameters do not cause internal service content or diagnostics to be returned.

tests.test_name: ATT&CK T1046 Network Service Discovery - public TCP exposure
tests.expected_result: Public high-risk backend ports are closed; expected public services are documented.

tests.test_name: ATT&CK T1071.001 Web Protocols - host service state
owasp_top_10: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
tests.expected_result: Core web, OSMAP, mail, filtering, and monitoring services report healthy state.

tests.test_name: OWASP A05 Security Misconfiguration - backend binding exposure
tests.expected_result: OSMAP, databases, Redis, and Rspamd controller bindings are loopback or VPN scoped, not public.

tests.test_name: ATT&CK Detection Support - pf and Suricata posture
owasp_top_10: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
tests.expected_result: pf is enabled with default drop posture and Suricata/PF integration artifacts are present.

tests.test_name: OWASP A01 Access Control - nginx public and private route split
tests.expected_result: Public OSMAP route and private control-plane routes remain separated in nginx configuration.

tests.test_name: ATT&CK T1071.001 Purple-Team Logging - benign web marker correlation
owasp_top_10: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
tests.expected_result: A unique benign web request marker from the operator network is visible in backend access logs, with IDS/PF context collected when available.

tests.test_name: OWASP A06 and A08 - mailstack security tooling alignment
owasp_top_10: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
tests.expected_result: The backend mailstack repo retains hardening, SBOM, Suricata, PF, Rspamd, and verification assets.

gaps.reason: The suite uses benign boundary probes and host telemetry review. It does not execute malware, deploy agents, transmit payloads, or attempt command-and-control callbacks.
The suite validates that adjacent applications are not publicly exposed. It does not log into SOGo, PostfixAdmin, Rspamd, or monitoring portals.
The suite adds automated assurance for OSMAP and border controls. It is not a complete application penetration test or formal OWASP certification.
